description.zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The application ID. You can create and query the ID in the console. Only a single ID can be specified.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 10 calls per second for each user. If you exceed this limit, rate limiting is triggered. This may affect your business. Call this API at a reasonable rate.
